description: Editing, deleting and excluding a speech clip.

preconditions: An existing sentence in a meeting whose Secretary is the actor (active user).
cases.inputs: clipId; actorId: the Secretary; text: corrected wording.
cases.return: Success (200, MSG302); the text, EditedBy and EditedAt are updated.

preconditions: An existing sentence; the actor is its meeting's Secretary.
cases.inputs: clipId; actorId: the Secretary; text: the current text unchanged.
cases.return: Success (200, MSG302); nothing is changed and no audit row is written.

preconditions: An existing sentence; the actor is an active Member (not the Secretary).
cases.inputs: clipId; actorId: the Member; text: corrected wording.

preconditions: An existing sentence; the actor is its meeting's Secretary.
cases.inputs: clipId; actorId: the Secretary; text of exactly 1 character.

preconditions: An existing sentence; the actor is its meeting's Secretary.
cases.inputs: clipId; actorId: the Secretary; text of exactly 8,000 characters.

preconditions: An existing sentence; the actor is its meeting's Secretary.
cases.inputs: clipId; actorId: the Secretary; text of 8,001 characters.
cases.return: Invalid (400, MSG303) with an error on text: “Nội dung từ 1 đến 8000 ký tự.”.

preconditions: An existing sentence; the actor is its meeting's Secretary.
cases.inputs: clipId; actorId: the Secretary; text of blanks only.
cases.return: Invalid (400, MSG303); blanks are trimmed to empty.

cases.inputs: clipId: a random id; actorId: a Secretary.

preconditions: The actor is not on the roster of the sentence's meeting.
An existing sentence; the actor is its meeting's Secretary.
cases.inputs: clipId; actorId: the Secretary; text: corrected wording.
cases.log: Error log 'Failed to edit speech clip'.
